# GeneralIntelligenceSubstrate

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A computational substrate designed to support general-purpose intelligence rather than task-specific functions, through flexible recursive structures. Guides the design of topology-centric networks that can reconfigure themselves for diverse cognitive tasks, a core TCC goal.
